about: The parameter audit (spec: Analyzers common to all vehicles, 'Parameter audit'). Names are canonical. The cell-voltage bands are the app's own, chosen to catch a setting made for another pack (a 3-cell value on a 12-cell aircraft) and not to judge a reasonable threshold; they are uncalibrated. BATT_CAPACITY counts as another pack's when it is more than capacity_share away from the capacity in the platform setup.

never_tuned.why: Every one of them at its default means the rate loops were never tuned for this aircraft.

dr_timeout.why: The operator's priority (platform setup, Links: link_loss = win_link_back) is to keep flying the failsafe home on dead reckoning so the radio link can be regained: the fleet owner chose 1800 s (2026-10-27), longer than any flight, so the battery failsafe acts first. ArduCopter accepts it past the documented 0 to 120 (params/beyond_range.json).
dr_timeout.source: ArduCopter/events.cpp at Copter-4.7.0, failsafe_deadreckon_check: FS_DR_TIMEOUT counts from the start of dead reckoning, after which a relative position is no longer accepted (system.cpp, ekf_has_relative_position) and the EKF failsafe acts

fs_thr.source: ArduCopter/AP_Arming_Copter.cpp at Copter-4.7.0, parameter checks: 'Check FS_THR_VALUE' fails when the throttle channel's minimum is at most FS_THR_VALUE + 10, or FS_THR_VALUE is below 910

starting_tune.about: Starting values by propeller diameter for an aircraft never tuned, offered only for parameters still at the firmware's default: Mission Planner's Initial Parameter Setup formulas (INS_GYRO_FILTER, the rate filters at half of it, ATC_ACC_*_MAX, MOT_THST_EXPO, INS_ACCEL_FILTER 10; not its ATC_RAT_YAW_FLTE 2, which 4.7's own default 2.5 replaces), with ArduPilot's AutoTune guidance that copters with props of 13 inches or more set the roll and pitch rate filters to 10 Hz, and its tuning guide's warning not to set MOT_THST_EXPO above 0.75 without thrust-stand data. ATC_ACC_*_MAX is only ever lowered.

starting_volts.about: Battery thresholds the app proposes where none is set, from the cell count and the chemistry's empty voltage per cell (cell_min): low = (cell_min + low_above_min) x cells, critical = (cell_min + critical_above_min) x cells, arming = (cells - 1) x arm_per_extra_cell + (cell_min + arm_above_min) x cells.
starting_volts.source: Mission Planner, GCSViews/ConfigurationView/ConfigInitialParams.cs calc_values() (the Initial Parameter Setup the ArduPilot tuning guide points to)
